searchText: MSRP $244,146. New 2027 Thor Motor Coach Tranquility 24C AWD equipped with Off-Road Tires and more. Features Silver Grey Off-Road Tires Lithium Batteries More About This RV The Tranquility is brought to life by a Mercedes-Benz diesel engine and is approximately 24 feet 4 inches in length. The Tranquility was made for compact and relaxed adventures with leatherette captain’s chairs with swivel and power patio awning with integrated LED lighting. This amazing new motor home also includes sliding screen door at entry way, multi-media touchscreen dash radio, back-up monitor, keyless entry system, aluminum wheels, stainless electric refrigerator, premium window shades, WiFi 4G Winegard Connect, solar panel with solar charge controller, lithium battery, 3000W Inverter and so much more.
